blurb:
The only ancestral witches tour company in New Orleans. 

A private Witches Coven tour takes you deep into the Witches Garden District, a neighborhood often seen as a symbol of wealth and prestige, but behind the grand homes and oak-lined streets, generations of ancestral witches and their families have lived, practiced, and passed down traditions that still echo today.

While popular culture has introduced audiences to fictional witches, this experience moves beyond imagination and into truth. Hear firsthand accounts from the descendants of the witches, as you explore the real history of New Orleans witchcraft and uncover stories that existed long before they were ever adapted for television or film.

Because this is a fully customized private tour, you are free to engage more deeply, ask questions, and linger in spaces that resonate.

Select your preferred start time and meeting location for a seamless experience. Optional enhancements can be added.
